verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say it supports sending and receiving money over ACH (unit-docs-2) and that its APIs expose payment and transaction data (unit-docs-5, unit-docs-11). A webhook events reference page exists (unit-docs-25), but nothing ties it to ACH events. Origination capability is documented only at a marketing level, and none of the story's specific mechanics are evidenced. missing for 10: explicit ACH credit vs debit origination endpoints, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class API objects, ACH-specific webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
